# Crontinel

> Completed is not done. Crontinel tells you when a background job finished without doing the work. Any runtime sends one HTTP receipt. The Laravel package attaches that receipt from the scheduler and can add queue depth and Horizon freshness.

- [Monitoring Failed Job Retry Loops in Laravel Horizon](https://crontinel.com/use-cases/failed-job-retry/): A job that fails and retries forever burns queue workers without progress. Crontinel detects rising failed job rates and oldest job age spikes early.

- [How to Monitor php artisan queue:flush in Production](https://crontinel.com/use-cases/monitor-queue-flush/): Monitor Laravel's queue:flush command in production. Get alerts when failed jobs are purged unexpectedly or on an unapproved schedule.
- [How to Monitor php artisan queue:forget in Production](https://crontinel.com/use-cases/monitor-queue-forget/): Monitor Laravel's queue:forget command in production. Get alerts when failed jobs are manually removed and their diagnostics disappear before review.

- [How to Monitor php artisan queue:monitor in Production](https://crontinel.com/use-cases/monitor-queue-monitor/): Monitor Laravel queue:monitor in production so you catch backed-up queues, QueueBusy events, and scheduler failures before the backlog turns into an incident.
- [How to Monitor php artisan queue:restart in Production](https://crontinel.com/use-cases/monitor-queue-restart/): Monitor Laravel queue:restart in production so you catch workers that never come back, cache mismatches, and silent queue stalls after deploys.
- [How to Monitor php artisan queue:retry in Production](https://crontinel.com/use-cases/monitor-queue-retry/): Monitor Laravel's queue:retry command in production. Get alerts when retry storms, repeated failures, or bad batches make recovery worse.
- [How to Monitor php artisan queue:work in Production](https://crontinel.com/use-cases/monitor-queue-work/): Monitor Laravel queue:work in production so you catch crashed workers, stale deploys, and memory leaks before your jobs start piling up.

- [Monitoring Redis Queue Performance in Laravel Production](https://crontinel.com/use-cases/monitor-redis-queue-performance/): Redis-backed queues degrade silently: latency creeps up, throughput drops, and jobs pile up. Here's how to detect Redis queue performance issues early.
- [How to Monitor Laravel Reverb Server in Production](https://crontinel.com/use-cases/monitor-reverb-server/): Laravel Reverb is a long-lived WebSocket server that can crash without notice. Detect when Reverb goes down, set up health checks, and get alerted early.

## Comparisons

- [Comparisons](https://crontinel.com/vs/): Crontinel compared with other monitoring tools
- [Best Crontinel Alternatives for Uptime Monitoring](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-alternatives/): Explore the best alternatives to Crontinel, including tools for uptime checks, cron monitoring, alerts, and team incident workflows.
- [Crontinel vs Better Stack for Uptime Monitoring](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-better-stack/): Compare Crontinel and Better Stack on cron monitoring, uptime checks, alerting, incident management, and pricing.
- [Crontinel vs Cronitor for Laravel Queue and Cron](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-cronitor/): Compare Crontinel vs Cronitor for Laravel apps so you can see the gap between ping-based dead-man alerts and Laravel-native Horizon and scheduler monitoring.
- [Crontinel vs Cronofy: Scheduling API vs Job Monitoring](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-cronofy/): Cronofy is a scheduling and calendar API. Crontinel monitors whether your scheduled jobs actually ran. Here's where they differ and when you need both.
- [Crontinel vs CronRadar for Laravel Cron and Queue Monitoring](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-cronradar/): CronRadar auto-discovers Laravel scheduled tasks. Crontinel adds Horizon supervisor state, queue depth, webhooks, status pages, and self-hosted OSS.
- [Crontinel vs Datadog: Which is better for uptime monitoring?](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-datadog/): Crontinel vs Datadog for cron job and uptime monitoring. Compare pricing, features, setup time, and which tool fits your team.
- [Crontinel vs Dead Man's Snitch for Laravel Monitoring](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-deadmanssnitch/): Dead Man's Snitch watches for cron pings. Crontinel watches your Laravel job layer: Horizon supervisors, queue depth, failed jobs, and scheduled tasks.
- [Crontinel vs Forge Heartbeats: Beyond Ping Monitoring](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-forge-heartbeats/): Forge Heartbeats tells you a job ran. Crontinel tells you what happened after it ran, whether your queues are healthy, and if Horizon is actually working.
- [Crontinel vs Healthchecks.io: Beyond Dead-Man Checks](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-healthchecks-io/): Healthchecks.io is a dead-man switch for cron jobs. Crontinel goes deeper: queue depth, Horizon supervisor state, and failed job rates, with no pings required.
- [Crontinel vs LambdaTest: Testing vs Job Monitoring](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-lambdatest/): LambdaTest runs your test suite in the cloud. Crontinel monitors whether your production jobs are running. Here's the difference and when you need both.
- [Crontinel vs Pingdom: Which is better for uptime monitoring?](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-pingdom/): Compare Crontinel and Pingdom on uptime monitoring, alerting, reliability, setup, and team fit, so you can choose the right tool for your team.
- [Crontinel vs thenping.me: Active Laravel Alternative](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-thenping/): thenping.me was a Laravel-native cron monitoring tool, archived in January 2025. Crontinel is actively maintained, with Horizon and queue monitoring added.
- [Crontinel vs UptimeRobot for Modern Monitoring Teams](https://crontinel.com/vs/crontinel-vs-uptimerobot/): Compare Crontinel and UptimeRobot for uptime monitoring, cron monitoring, alerting, and modern team workflows.

## Integrations

- [Integrations](https://crontinel.com/integrations/): Alert channels and framework integrations
- [Crontinel Discord Integration: Cron and Queue Alerts](https://crontinel.com/integrations/discord/): Route Crontinel Laravel alerts to Discord with a webhook URL. Get notified when scheduled tasks fail, queues back up, or Horizon supervisors pause.
- [Crontinel Laravel Integration: Setup and Configuration](https://crontinel.com/integrations/laravel/): Install Crontinel in a Laravel application. Configure the OSS package, publish migrations, set alert channels, and connect to the cloud dashboard quickly.
- [Crontinel Microsoft Teams Integration via Webhook](https://crontinel.com/integrations/microsoft-teams/): Send Crontinel Laravel monitoring alerts to Microsoft Teams using an Incoming Webhook connector on your team channel.
- [Crontinel PagerDuty Integration for Laravel Monitoring](https://crontinel.com/integrations/pagerduty/): Create and auto-resolve PagerDuty incidents from Crontinel. Use Events API v2 with dedup keys to get one incident per failure, not a flood of alerts.
- [Crontinel Slack Integration: Cron and Queue Alerts](https://crontinel.com/integrations/slack/): Send Crontinel alerts to Slack. Configure an incoming webhook, choose a channel, and get notified when a Laravel cron job fails or Horizon pauses.
- [Crontinel Telegram Integration: Cron and Queue Alerts](https://crontinel.com/integrations/telegram/): Deliver Crontinel Laravel alerts to Telegram via bot API or webhook relay. Good for solo founders and small teams who live in Telegram.
- [Crontinel Webhook Integration: Route Alerts to Any Endpoint](https://crontinel.com/integrations/webhook/): Send Crontinel alerts to any HTTPS endpoint via webhook. Build custom alert routing, connect to Opsgenie, or handle alerts in your own infrastructure.

## Connect

- [HTTP receipt](https://crontinel.com/#sec-install): POST /api/v1/ingest/cron with the app ingest key
- [Laravel package](https://github.com/crontinel/laravel): Schedule attach, queue depth, and Horizon. Outcome metrics are on GitHub main, not the current Packagist release.
